subject: Strategic recap: customer outcomes, risk posture, and procurement playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Strategic recap: customer outcomes, risk posture, and procurement playbook

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested procurement playbook so we have a single source of truth for exec review. I captured the key business outcomes, current risks blocking a pilot, and the recommended path to a 6-week pilot.

Summary of customer goals (what we heard)
- Reduce inference cost per transaction by ~40% while lowering tail latency for 99th percentile responses to <200ms for core workflows.
- Move critical inference for PHI-adjacent traffic into a VPC/private deployment for data residency and auditability.
- Run a constrained pilot (10K daily QPS cap, 1 model variant) with measurable business KPIs (latency, cost/unit, accuracy drift) before committing to dedicated capacity.

Primary risks / blockers
- Security & compliance: need SOC2 evidence and answers to IdP/KMS questions.
- Procurement: Cygnus prefers a short MSA + SOW approach and will require legal review of data residency clauses.
- Exec alignment: CTO wants a financial projection and clear rollback criteria if accuracy drifts in production.

Proposed procurement playbook (recommended owners & timeline)
1) Pilot proposal + SOW (attached: redwood-pilot-proposal-v1.pdf) — Owner: Jordan — deliver by 11/18
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 summary — Owner: Karthik — deliver by 11/19; include KMS/HSM options and KYC evidence
3) Legal review (MSA draft via DocuSign link below) — Owner: Tom Hale / Cygnus legal, Redwood will provide redlines — target complete by 11/24
4) Pilot kickoff & acceptance criteria (success metrics, rollback plan) — Owner: Marissa — target kickoff 11/30

Immediate asks (action items)
- Elena / Tom: confirm the pilot scope (10K daily QPS cap, single model variant) and whether the pilot will run in Cygnus VPC or Redwood Private. Reply here by EOD 11/18.
- Cygnus legal: please review the enclosed MSA draft link and flag any data residency or audit clauses that require special handling.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-proposal-v1.pdf
Related links: HubSpot deal (link below), Draft MSA (DocuSign)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the formal SOW + timeline by Wednesday.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cygnushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@cygnushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Strategic recap: customer outcomes, risk posture, and procurement playbook

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our conversation. A few clarifications from our side before we circulate to execs:  

1) Data residency: the pilot must ensure all PHI-adjacent logs are retained within our GCP org and accessible to our audit team. Can you confirm whether Redwood Private or a VPC-hosted Redwood instance will satisfy that, and who will hold keys (customer-managed KMS)?

2) Cost projection: we need a ballpark TCO estimate for the pilot (approximate cost per 10K daily requests with the proposed batching + KV cache configuration). If you can provide a 3-line estimate (best / expected / conservative) that would help the CFO sign off.

3) Timeline: 11/30 kickoff sounds fine, but legal will need the MSA/short SOW ASAP. I’ll ask Tom to prioritize review; he’s cc’d.

If you can fold those answers into the SOW and send back by 11/18 we’ll put this on the CTO’s calendar.

Onward —
Elena Rios
VP Product, Cygnus Health
elena.rios@cygnushealth.com

Elena / team — quick note from the security & deployment side to address the questions you raised:  

- Deployment & keys: For the pilot we can run Redwood Private within your GCP project using a customer-managed VPC. Customer-managed KMS is supported; keys remain in your KMS. I can include an ops diagram in the SOW.

- SOC2 & evidence: attaching a short SOC2-summary.pdf with the high-level control mapping. We can also provide scoped audit logs and an A&A package for your audit team.

- Cost estimate (10K daily requests) — rough three-line estimate (includes infra + inference units + support):
  • Best case (aggressive batching + cache): $3,200 / month
  • Expected: $4,800 / month
  • Conservative (no cache, dedicated throughput): $7,100 / month

- Security questionnaire: I’ll start the questionnaire responses and aim to deliver a first pass by 11/19. If there are specific items your audit team wants prioritized, drop them into the HubSpot notes or reply here.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, procurement-timeline.xlsx

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Elena / team — looping in to confirm onboarding & pilot ops.

I’ll own the pilot runbook and weekly checkpoints. Proposed immediate calendar items:
- Pilot kickoff (30 min) — Tue 11/30 10:00 AM PT — invite to follow (calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cygnus-pilot-kickoff)
- Weekly checkpoint (30 min) — Fridays 9:00 AM PT (first checkpoint 12/03)

Acceptance criteria (to include in SOW):
- 99th percentile latency <= 200ms for core endpoints measured across representative traffic
- Observed cost per 1K requests decreases by >= 25% vs current baseline
- No critical security findings in the initial review

DocuSign MSA: Jordan will push the MSA draft; when legal is ready I can coordinate signatures and the technical onboarding steps.

Next steps (short):
1) Jordan: final SOW + 3-line cost estimate (due 11/18) — Jordan
2) Karthik: security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence (due 11/19) — Karthik
3) Cygnus legal: review MSA (target 11/24) — Tom
4) Marissa: schedule kickoff and runbook (invite 11/21) — Marissa

Looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Marissa Cole
